name: move_appointment
description: Step two of a move. WRITE OPERATION, and it takes no details — only the token from a prepare_booking call that carried booking_ref_to_move, and confirmed. Never call it before the caller has heard the readback_fr or readback_en that prepare_booking returned, read out verbatim, and answered it with a clear yes. Set confirmed to true only then; set it to false if you have not read the read-back yet — the call is rejected with error "not_confirmed". If the token is missing, already used, or was minted for a new booking instead of a move, the call is rejected with error "needs_prepare" and you must call prepare_booking again. If more than ten minutes passed, the call is rejected with error "token_expired" and you must call prepare_booking again. The phone number on the booking is checked by prepare_booking: error "phone_mismatch" means the number does not match, and you must not try other numbers.

token.description: The token returned by the prepare_booking call (with booking_ref_to_move) whose read-back the caller just agreed to. Do not change or re-use one.

confirmed.description: True only after the caller has heard the prepare_booking read-back for the new time, read out verbatim, and said yes to it. False otherwise.
